mechanism: Turmeric (curcumin) may inhibit CYP3A4 and CYP2C9 enzymes and potentiate bleeding risk through antiplatelet effects, while acetaminophen undergoes hepatic metabolism and carries inherent hepatotoxicity risk that may be compounded by turmeric's hepatic effects at high doses.
action: Monitor liver function tests with concurrent use; avoid high-dose turmeric supplementation in patients taking acetaminophen regularly, and counsel patients on bleeding precautions if turmeric is used as a supplement.
